positive_checks.claim: SAM benefits more than one base unlearning method
positive_checks.result: NPO,GradDiff,RMU each improve after attack in every displayed attack column; repeated N20/M1 entries and repeated NPO rows agree across tables.
SAM-minus-NPO UE gains are.03AGNews,.05GSM8K,.05SST2 at the stated60sample1epoch budget.
SAM reduces post-attack VerbMem/KnowMem by5.10/2.84points forNews and9.14/7.00 forBooks. RetainKnowMem improves by1.00/0.77points.
rho=.01 exactly matches TableA2 Books SAM row. All pre-attack forgetting scores are0.00. rho=.001 has mixed changes versus NPO: postVerbMem+3.38(worse), postKnowMem-2.83(better), utility+2.70.
SAM andTAR both haveUE.74before,.70after. SAMUT=.51 versusTAR.54. Reported times11.5min versus7441.9min giveTAR/SAM≈647.12; SAM/NPO≈1.98. No independent hardware-normalized timing reproduction.
UE values NPO.43,SAM.73,RS.73,CR.63,GP.53,WA.45 support a relative advantage. SAM/RS are.01below theirTable2 no-attackUE.74; 'lossless' should be read as approximate rather than an exact equality.
DisplayedUE rises.36→.38→.41 forRMU, SAMlayers5–7, SAMlayers1–7, matching the local narrative. This single ablation is not a universal scaling guarantee.

mathematical_counterevidence: Eq4 explicitly linearizes the inner maximization; its closed-form optimizer of the linearized problem is correct. The audit does not misrepresent it as an exact maximizer of arbitrary nonlinear losses.
Eq6 is explicitly a first-order Taylor approximation and Eq8 a finite-difference approximation. These local relations are retained.
The conditional min-max formulation requires a relearning objective counteracting the forget objective and a bounded weight-perturbation threat set; it can remain a useful robust surrogate.
AlgorithmA1 intentionally bypasses higher-order derivatives. In the scalar counterexample v is locally constant, so this bypass does not remove the counterexample.
The analysis does not demonstrate diminished empirical UE/UT, failure of all smoothing, or ineffective unlearning. Empirical score verification is separate.
Even a valid local directional-curvature reduction would not itself be a certificate against unrestricted fine-tuning or every attack; the paper's measured attack results remain empirical.
